title: Ruthless Berry Drank Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Berry Drank by Ruthless takes the essence of classic berry sodas and transforms it into a bold and satisfying vape. A medley of dark and juicy berries—including Blueberry, Blackcurrant, and Boysenberry—creates a deep, layered fruit flavour with a rich sweetness. The addition of a fizzy soda base adds a refreshing, sparkling quality that lifts the darker berry notes, resulting in a perfectly balanced vape that’s smooth, fruity, and refreshing. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Berry Drank features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense vapour production and a smooth, well-rounded inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. For over a decade, Ruthless has been a leader in the e-liquid industry, crafting bold and innovative flavour profiles that have influenced countless others. Their dedication to premium ingredients and expert blending ensures a high-quality vaping experience with every bottle.
